stateMeaning.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No adequate baseline for this seasonal cell yet, so {what} is not being judged. That is not the same as being healthy.
stateMeaning.NORMAL: The measurement is within the expected range for this weekday and hour.
stateMeaning.CANDIDATE: One abnormal interval recorded. Not yet an incident: promotion requires consecutive abnormal intervals.
stateMeaning.OPEN: Confirmed incident: enough consecutive abnormal intervals to rule out a single-bucket artefact.
stateMeaning.RECOVERING: Back inside the expected range, but held open until enough consecutive normal intervals confirm it.
stateMeaning.SUPPRESSED: Detected while the source was in maintenance. Recorded for history, never notified.

banner.partialBody: {notExact} of {stored} stored buckets were not measured exactly{extra}. A figure from those buckets does not support a claim of exact volume or exact normality.
banner.partialNotMeasured: ; {count} of them carry no usable value and are drawn as gaps
banner.truncatedBody: Entity admission lost entities to the quota, ceiling or top-N cut in {count} of {stored} buckets, so the inventory for those buckets is incomplete. This entity''s own counts are shown; nothing is implied about entities that were not admitted.
banner.maintenanceBody: {count, plural, one {# bucket was in maintenance and is outlined on the chart: the engine does not judge them.} other {# buckets were in maintenance and are outlined on the chart: the engine does not judge them.}}
banner.baselineUnavailableBody: The seasonal cells could not be loaded, so the band is the range recorded at detection, not a per-bucket one.
banner.insufficientBody: No seasonal cell of this metric is reliable yet, so no expected band is drawn for any bucket. The recorded range at detection, if any, is shown instead. That is not the same as a normal baseline.

editor.presetNote: A preset fills in defaults for a product. It is a starting point only: the profile still has to validate against this source’s events before anything is collected.

editor.validatesSaved: Validates the saved version {version}, not your unsaved edits.
editor.busyBefore: The last validation of version {version} did not run: another job held this source. The result below is the previous one, and nothing was changed. Validate again.
editor.valuesSubtitle: Which raw {action} values count as {outcomes}. Saving this map is a mapping change: it bumps the version and validates again.
editor.actionUnmappedBody: Neither Cisco Firepower Threat Defense nor Palo Alto THREAT exposes an action in a QRadar field, so a site authors a custom property for it in QRadar and maps it here. Until it is mapped, the block ratio cannot be judged: it is reported as insufficient data, never as no blocks.
editor.truncatedNote: The probe lists at most 20 {action} values and this field has more, so the last validation was inconclusive. Values not listed count as unmapped, never as allowed.
editor.discoveredNote: These values were counted under {reference}; the mapping now reads {mapping}. Validate again to refresh them.
editor.historyFailed: The history could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again; the profile itself is unaffected.
editor.createBody: The profile is created disabled. Collection from this source stays off until version 1 validates and you enable it. Validation starts now and runs a few bounded searches against QRadar.
editor.presetTail: The preset only filled in defaults; they are validated like any other mapping.
editor.mappedBody: Collection from this source pauses until version {version} validates. Validation starts now and runs a few bounded searches against QRadar.
editor.labelOnlyBody: Only the product label changes. The version, its validation and collection are unaffected.
